articles.title: BIG! Iran's 'Super Weapon', Putin's Deadly Upgrade Pummels Ukraine; Zelensky Aide Cries Foul | WATCH
articles.description: Ukraine’s ambassador to Israel, Yevgen Korniychuk, says Russia’s war against Ukraine and Israel’s conflict with Iran are part of the same broader struggle, with Iranian-made drones linking the two battlefields. Speaking to The Jerusalem Post ahead of Ukraine’s Independence Day, Korniychuk said Ukraine has been attacked by the same Iranian-made drones that Russia has deployed in the war. He argued that growing military cooperation between Moscow and Tehran has created a direct connection between the threats facing Ukraine and Israel. The ambassador said Ukraine and Israel are "fighting the same enemy in different corners of the same battlefield," describing what he called an emerging "axis of evil."

articles.description: Quote of the day by Usain Bolt offers a timeless reminder that manners are among the simplest ways to demonstrate respect. articles.title: Houthi Drones Hit Saudi! Najran Airport & Aramco Facility Targeted In Fresh Attack
articles.description: Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthi movement has claimed two drone strikes against Saudi Arabia, targeting Najran Airport and an Aramco facility in the southern Najran region near the Yemeni border. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the group carried out the operations as tensions between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia continue to escalate. The claims have not been independently verified. The reported strikes come after Iran’s Revolutionary Guards warned that Saudi Arabia would be unable to contain the Houthis. The group has also threatened Saudi shipping and critical infrastructure, raising fresh concerns over regional security and the future of vital trade routes around the Red Sea.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Amy Adams, 'I think a lot of times we don't pay enough attention to people with a positive attitude because we assume they are naive or stupid or unschooled' teaches powerful timeless meaning of positivity, maturity, kindness, caring, compassion, empathy, human connection and emotions
articles.description: Quote of the day by Amy Adams offers a timely lesson about optimism, intelligence, resilience, and the power of perspective. A positive attitude should not automatically be confused with ignorance, just as pessimism should not automatically be mistaken for wisdom. The strongest outlook often combines realism with hope: seeing problems clearly while remaining willing to search for solutions.
